cand.title: Strategic Airport Management: Optimizing Operations & Growth – Geneva

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two current-role contact candidates: Jim KADRİ, Training Manager at BlackBird Training Centre (profile lists April 2019–present), and Süheyla Şerifoğlu, Operations Specialist (January 2026–present). Their roles support programme/operations introductions, but neither is verified as the Geneva venue buyer or hotel contracting signatory. Süheyla’s profile describes hotel/transport agreement experience at a previous employer, not contract control at Blackbird. Route through the published organizational address training@blackbird-training.co.uk and ask for the Geneva venue decision-maker.
findings.futureEdition: Official edition page publishes 10–14 May 2027 in Geneva, Switzerland, in person, open for registration, £5,200 course fee. These are activity dates, not publication dates. The linked second Geneva session is officially published for 11–15 October 2027. Both fall within the requested horizon. These are advertised sessions, not evidence of paid participants or guaranteed delivery. No Geneva edition for January–June 2028 was identified in the sources reviewed.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: a five-day professional course is a plausible training-room and optional accommodation use for YOTEL Geneva Lake, rather than a resort or mega-convention product. Its six flexible rooms may suit a cohort, but no participant count or classroom specification is published, so capacity fit and commercial materiality are unqualified. Founex is not downtown Geneva: prioritize a combined course-venue proposal only if Blackbird accepts the airport/La Côte location. If the course remains in central Geneva, consider only optional satellite lodging after confirming independent booking and workable transfers. Do not assume a 20–120-room block, whole-house demand, restaurant capacity or banquet provision.
findings.venueCommitments: Exact venue: not published on the reviewed edition pages. Published city: Geneva, Switzerland; precise venue address, region and submarket remain unverified. Cannot classify the actual venue as Geneva city versus the airport corridor, or place it in Founex/Nyon/La Côte. No edition-specific hotel commitment identified. The London address in the footer is the organizer contact address, not the course venue.
findings.historicalRotation: An official Blackbird .com listing advertised Strategic Airport Management in Geneva for 19–23 October 2026; this is historical as of 17 November 2026. Delivery and venue are unverified, and its shorter title/different syllabus means it is related programme evidence, not proven identical-edition lineage. The .co.uk series lists parallel sessions in many cities, not an exclusive host-destination rotation. Two Geneva dates in 2027 are verified; an annual or twice-yearly long-term cadence is not.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Organizer-wide FAQ explicitly states: “Do you help with hotel bookings? No, we book only training venues.” Fees include “Venue, coffee breaks, airport pickup” and exclude “flights and accommodation.” This supports a direct training-venue approach to Blackbird and a separate delegate/employer accommodation pathway (the latter is an inference, not a published booking process). No housing bureau, host hotel, named room block, open RFP or incumbent hotel is identified for this edition. Hotels listed for this edition: none found. Hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed, not open.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial professional-training provider, not an association congress or a verified travel agency/PCO/DMC. Its official contact page names BLACKBIRD TRAINING CENTRE LIMITED; its .com homepage describes a UK-based professional training and development company. The FAQ says it books training venues rather than hotels. Legal-entity verification is still needed before contracting: the .co.uk site displays 1661230, while the same-named Companies House record is 13017735; these should not be silently treated as matching registration numbers.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No competing hotel or edition-specific allocation is evidenced; that does not establish availability. The main evidenced limitation is that Blackbird says it does not book accommodation. Course registrations, hotel conversion, room nights and repeat production are unknown. A fixed downtown training venue could weaken Founex lodging appeal (inference). No sourced overflow, compression, sell-out, competitor capacity shortfall or displacement evidence was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact training@blackbird-training.co.uk, requesting Jim KADRİ or Süheyla Şerifoğlu and the actual Geneva venue buyer. Reference both exact 2027 sessions. First request venue name/address, booking status and decision deadline, expected/paid delegates, daily room layout/AV needs, and who books accommodation. Ask whether an airport/La Côte venue and hotel option in Founex is acceptable and whether hotel details can be shared with delegates/employers. Only then offer a right-sized training-room/coffee-break proposal and optional room rate; validate catering and transfers separately. If May is contracted elsewhere, request consideration for October without implying an open tender.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: May 2027 is upcoming and registration is advertised as open; hotel procurement is not advertised as open. Current-edition access is therefore a discovery conversation with programme/operations staff, not a live housing lead. The FAQ offers airport pickup and says a driver takes the participant to their hotel, but this is general policy: it does not establish Geneva Airport arrivals for this cohort, a Founex transfer service, or La Côte lodging. No Lausanne or French-border venue is established; no edition-specific travel evidence supports either.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: The separately announced 11–15 October 2027 Geneva session gives a second specific conversation point even if May venue procurement is closed. Inference: seek a nonexclusive training-venue relationship and an optional delegate hotel rate for independently booked stays, subject to actual cohort volumes and location acceptance. Neither a future RFP nor recurring room demand is verified; no 2028 date should be generated from the 2027 pattern.
